Individual: There are 3 star unlocks per level, which individually unlock star completion locations on each level.
Progressive Per Level: There are 3 star unlocks items per level, which progressively unlock star completion locations on each level.
Progressive Per Box: There are 3 star unlocks items per box, which progressively unlock star completion locations on each box.
